canonical_name: No Supply Chain Risk Communication Lines
description: Lines of communication for cybersecurity risks across the supply chain are not established.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing vendor risk communication processes, absence of third-party risk escalation paths, lack of supply chain risk reporting mechanisms, undefined communication channels for supplier security incidents.
